integration_policy: Add one option and one inline job only; preserve every existing byte. Root owns actual integration and current SDK central-row rebind. Do not add a reusable-workflow reference.

steps.name: Checkout only the exact diagnostic source
Bind the dispatched branch without advancing its commit
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "codex/chatgpt-wave15-shared-20261121"
current_branch="$(git branch --show-current)"
if [ -z "$current_branch" ]; then
  git switch -c "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
else
  test "$current_branch" = "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
fi
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"

steps.name: Select an already installed ARM64 Python without downloading a runtime
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
shopt -s nullglob
candidates=()
default_python="$(command -v python3 || true)"
if [ -n "$default_python" ]; then candidates+=("$default_python"); fi
if [ -n "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE:-}" ]; then
  for candidate in "$RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE"/Python/3.12.*/arm64/bin/python3; do
    candidates+=("$candidate")
  done
fi
test "${#candidates[@]}" -gt 0
test "${#candidates[@]}" -le 12
selected=''
for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do
  if "$candidate" -I -B -c 'import platform,sys; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3,12) and platform.machine() == "arm64"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    selected="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
test -n "$selected"
printf 'DIAGNOSTIC_PYTHON=%s\n' "$selected" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
"$selected" -I -B -c 'import platform,sys; print(sys.executable); print(sys.version); print(platform.machine())'
